programme.title: Kala Sindoor
programme.desc: Maya believes in black magic and, as a result, she tries to take the wrong step. Her in-laws finish her after witnessing this, but her soul continues to haunt them.

programme.title: Chugalkhor Bahuriya
programme.desc: A married woman finds herself gossiping in every given situation, leading to strains on the many relationships around her.

programme.title: Shubh Lagan
programme.desc: A young man rebels against an arranged marriage, pursuing his true love instead. However, his choice ignites familial chaos and forces him to grapple with the consequences of following his heart.

programme.title: Saas Bahu Yamraj
programme.desc: Bringing the best in cinema.

programme.title: Ek Duuje Ke Liye 2
programme.desc: An Indian boy living in London falls head over heels in love with a British girl. However, things take a chaotic turn when his mother's wishes prevent their union.

programme.title: Hogi Pyaar Ki Jeet
programme.desc: This is Film - Drama Category.

programme.title: Lalaki Chunariya Odh Ke
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of melodious devotional songs performed by talented musicians is played in quick succession.

programme.title: Diwana
programme.desc: Pyarelal, a lovable orphan, is taken in by a Muslim lady. When he gets arrested for murder, no one believes it, but to everyone's shock he admits that he is guilty.

programme.title: Shalimar
programme.desc: Kumar, a thief, aspires to be mafia boss Sir John's successor by stealing Shalimar, a priceless diamond. Adamant to succeed in his mission, Kumar must overcome many tribulations to seize the diamond.

programme.title: Anari
programme.desc: The film follows Raja and Poonam, a young couple whose romance is strained by extreme poverty, family responsibilities, and a tempting, immoral job offer, putting their love and moral compass to the test

programme.title: Nascut din otel
programme.desc: Filmul urmărește povestea unor oameni prinși într-un joc periculos al loialității și trădării, într-un oraș plin de tensiuni.

programme.title: Strigatul dreptatii
programme.desc: Un actor popular de la Bollywood asistă la o crimă, dar refuză să iasă în față pentru a identifica criminalul.

programme.title: Flacarile iubirii
programme.desc: O fată bogată și un băiat din clasa de mijloc se iubesc, dar mama vitregă se opune. Fug împreună, ajutați de un avocat. Un asasin trimis să-l omoare descoperă adevărul și îi sprijină pe îndrăgostiți.

programme.title: Trantorul
programme.desc: Un pierde-vară și cumnata lui, o femeie muncitoare și disciplinată, nu se suportă deloc. Dar când un pericol comun le amenință familia, cei doi sunt forțați să lase deoparte diferențele și să lupte împreună.

programme.title: In umbra armelor
programme.desc: Un infractor priceput la tras devine trăgător de elită în competiții, în timp ce prietenul său din copilărie rămâne prins în lumea crimei.

programme.title: Sukhee
programme.desc: Spre disperarea soțului ei, o gospodină din clasa de mijloc, cunoscută pentru atitudinea ei rebelă din liceu, decide să participe la reuniunea de clasă.

programme.title: Partea întunecată a legii
programme.desc: Vijay Salgaonkar, un bărbat cu o condiție modestă și doar 4 clase, mare amator de filme, ajunge sfătuitor justițiar pentru mai multe persoane. Cu ajutorul informațiilor primite din filme el reușește să-și depășească condiția celor 4 clase...

programme.title: Vreau să fiu al tău
programme.desc: Rămas orfan la o vârstă foarte fragedă, un tânăr este luat de un gangster și antrenat să accepte crima ca fiind cariera sa. Într-o zi, el dă peste un copil abandonat și decide să îl adopte. Acest lucru îi schimbă viața, iar el decide să se îndrepte.

programme.title: Iubirea prințesei Jodhaa
programme.desc: O poveste de dragoste din secolul 16 despre căsătoria aranjată dintre un împărat mongol şi o prinţesă din Rajput, pe nume Jodha, se transformă în dragoste reală.

programme.title: In transa
programme.desc: Un speaker motivațional deziluzionat acceptă să devină predicator pentru o corporație aflată în căutarea unui nou suflu spiritual. Însă apariția sa în direct la TV atrage atenția publicului și ridică semne de întrebare asupra sincerității sale...

programme.title: Fratia strazii
programme.desc: Patru prieteni, prinși în lumea interlopă, își pun în pericol viețile personale, ajungând într-un punct fără întoarcere.

programme.title: Hello Hum Lallann Bol Rahe Hain
programme.desc: Un paznic organizează căsătoria femeii pe care o iubește cu alt bărbat.

programme.title: Avere si destin
programme.desc: Kashinath și Imli, iubiți din copilărie, văd cum viața lor se complică când apare Anjali. Dragoste, boală și sacrificii le vor testa relația și devotamentul.

programme.title: Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna
programme.desc: Dev locuieste in SUA si e fotbalist. E insurat cu Ryna. Dev iai rupe piciorul, dezvolta un handicap si devine dependent de Ryna. Acasa, singur, incepe sa-si faca de lucru, iar apoi incepe s-o suspecteze pe Ryna ca ar avea o aventura cu un alt barbat.

programme.title: Ghulam-E-Musthafa
programme.desc: Un gangster renunță la viața criminală după ce iubita lui este ucisă de rivali, dar șeful său îl forțează să revină pentru o ultimă misiune.

programme.title: Bodyguardul
programme.desc: Bodyguard este un film indian romantic şi de acţiune. Este cel de-al treilea remake al filmului Bodyguard. În rolurile principale îi putem vedea pe Salman Khan şi Kareena Kapoor.

programme.title: Prieteni
programme.desc: Trei bărbați aproape identici devin prieteni buni după ce se cunosc printr-o aplicație online de căutare a sosiei. Totul este distractiv până când unul dintre ei se dovedește a fi un fugar notoriu.

programme.title: Supraviețuitoarea
programme.desc: O tânără se mută în Mumbai după ce își pierde părinții, iar orașul său este distrus în urma conflictelor religioase. Ca să supraviețuiască se angajează în calitate de dansatoare într-un bar.

programme.title: Ce se intampla, draga mea?
programme.desc: O comedie plină de încurcături care străbate zonele rurale din Haryana, dezvăluind relații haotice, situații nebunești și excentricități în rândul familiei, prietenilor, îndrăgostiților și chiar al polițiștilor!

programme.title: Maior la datorie
programme.desc: Filmul este inspirat din viața maiorului Sandeep Unnikrishnan, eroul care a luptat cu curaj în timpul atacurilor teroriste din Mumbai, în noiembrie 2008. O poveste despre sacrificiu, onoare și datoria dusă până la capăt.

programme.title: Pamantul - 1947
programme.desc: În Lahore, 1947, înaintea separării Indiei de Pakistan, un grup de prieteni cu credințe diferite își petrec zilele împreună. După separare, tensiunile cresc, iar tânăra Lenny, alături de dadaca ei Shanta, asistă la destrămarea armoniei din jurul lor.

programme.title: Baazaar
programme.desc: După ce se mută la Mumbai, un tânăr ambițios devine trader de acțiuni pentru un om de afaceri cunoscut pentru activitățile sale dubioase.

programme.title: Steaua de mare
programme.desc: O călătorie frumoasă prin adâncurile lumii subacvatice, în timp ce suntem martorii unei povești captivante despre durere și vindecare care se desfășoară sub ochii noștri.

programme.title: Cantec nevazut
programme.desc: O serie de evenimente misterioase îi schimbă viața unui pianist orb, care acum trebuie să raporteze o crimă despre care, teoretic, nu ar trebui să știe nimic.

programme.title: Ek Anjaan Rishtey Ka Guilt
programme.desc: Saru este căsătorită cu Pratap, ofițer de poliție, însă problemele de intimitate dintre ei creează o ruptură în mariaj. Saru găsește sprijin în Sunil, prietenul din copilărie al soțului ei. Apropierea dintre ei se transformă treptat într-o relație...

programme.title: Sukhee
programme.desc: Spre disperarea soțului ei, o gospodină din clasa de mijloc, cunoscută pentru atitudinea ei rebelă din liceu, decide să participe la reuniunea de clasă.

programme.title: Naqaab
programme.desc: Indragostita de un baiat bogat, Sofia, o tanara din clasa d mijloc, incepe sa il indrageasca pe Vicky...

programme.title: Seful
programme.desc: Boss ia asupra sa vina pentru o crimă comisă din greșeală de tatăl său. După închisoare, devine un gangster temut, dar viața lui ia o turnură periculoasă când un polițist corupt și un politician îi cer să ucidă, punându-l într-o dilemă cumplită.

programme.title: Iubirea prințesei Jodhaa
programme.desc: O poveste de dragoste din secolul 16 despre căsătoria aranjată dintre un împărat mongol şi o prinţesă din Rajput, pe nume Jodha, se transformă în dragoste reală.

programme.title: Trăiește clipa
programme.desc: Desi o iubeste nespus de mult, Aman incearca sa o impinga in bratele prietenului ei cel mai bun, Rohit. Reuseste, iar cand Naina era deja fericita de noua schimbare, afla ca Aman e pe moarte si ca de fapt el s-a sacrificat pentru ea.

programme.title: Auzaar
programme.desc: Yash și Suraj, prieteni buni, urmează drumuri diferite: Yash preia afacerea tatălui său mafiot, iar Suraj devine ofițer CBI. Când tatăl lui Yash este atacat, acesta jură răzbunare, iar Suraj începe o anchetă care le va testa prietenia.

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.sub-title: The manufacturing of Skippy peanut butter, aubergine Parmesan, Wonderful pistachios and chocolate bars filled with tortilla chips and candy
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life
programme.sub-title: Jonathan had his dream job, and he ate himself out of it. Once an EMT first responder, now he rarely leaves the room. His wife works full-time to pay their bills, and Jonathan must break the cycle of eating if he wants to keep his wife and his life
programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.title: Houdini's Last Secrets
programme.sub-title: How did Harry Houdini pull off his death-defying escapes? A team of experts investigates his illusions to reveal the secrets of this mysterious stunt
programme.desc: Cracking a magician's code used to be strictly against industry standards. Now, it seems the magic has disappeared from that concept, and even legendary performers such as Harry Houdini are not immune. This series looks to uncover the methods to Houdini's breathtaking escapes and astonishing illusions, which have never been equalled or fully understood. How did this showman catch a speeding bullet, submerge himself in a water torture cell, or survive being buried alive? Helping piece together clues and testing out his most daring stunts are Houdini's grand-nephew George Hardeen, magician and daredevil Lee Terbosic, and master stunt builder Steve Wolf.

programme.title: Bering Sea Gold
programme.sub-title: Shawn has a bold plan to rebuild the Myrtle Irene. Zeke tests out his unique sailboat dredge, and Vernon exams his claim with an underwater drone
programme.desc: The gold rush in Alaska isn't confined to the state's precious ground. It's taking place on the sea ... or more accurately, on the bottom of the frigid Bering Sea. This series, from the creators of the Emmy-winning \"Deadliest Catch,\" follows four gold dredges and their eccentric and driven crews who risk their lives to find as much gold as possible before winter sets in and it's too dangerous to dive. The custom-built rigs, some barely seaworthy, include an 80-foot barge run by the most successful gold dredger in Nome, Alaska, and a modified skiff that seats only two people.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.sub-title: Zak and the crew suspect evil forces are afoot as they investigate an estate haunted by rumours of secret rituals in the basement and a gruesome double homicide next door; the team treads on very dark grounds as they attempt to unravel the mystery
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. programme.title: Curse of the Bermuda Triangle

programme.title: Houdini's Last Secrets
programme.sub-title: Houdini's mysterious sudden death may not have been an accident. Experts recreate his buried alive escape and investigate if he was killed by more sinister forces
programme.desc: Cracking a magician's code used to be strictly against industry standards. Now, it seems the magic has disappeared from that concept, and even legendary performers such as Harry Houdini are not immune. This series looks to uncover the methods to Houdini's breathtaking escapes and astonishing illusions, which have never been equalled or fully understood. How did this showman catch a speeding bullet, submerge himself in a water torture cell, or survive being buried alive? Helping piece together clues and testing out his most daring stunts are Houdini's grand-nephew George Hardeen, magician and daredevil Lee Terbosic, and master stunt builder Steve Wolf.

programme.title: You Have Been Warned
programme.sub-title: The smartest and bravest people use science to take their skills to the next level, from designing a robotic drawing arm to making a bike that exercises the whole body
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

credits.actor: Alistair Linsell,Timothy Dabado,Helen Arney,Debbie Berebichez,Hakeem Oluseyi,Adam Ruben

programme.title: Live: Get Up
programme.desc: ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Hudson Square in Lower Manhattan, a modern media hub for ESPN and The Walt Disney Company's New York-based teams. Greenberg, aka "Greeny," is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime "Mike & Mike" morning show.

programme.title: Live: First Take
programme.desc: Stephen A. Smith hosts this weekday morning sports debate show. Smith provides his expert takes on the day's trending sports topics and under-the-radar news. They're regularly joined by veteran analysts and the top guests in sports and entertainment.

programme.title: Live: The Pat McAfee Show
programme.desc: Former NFL punter Pat McAfee brings his humor and candor to the microphone to highlight the day's top stories.

programme.desc: Peter Schrager's daily show will feature rotating panelists focusing heavily on the NFL while also providing coverage of other major sports stories.

programme.title: Live: NBA Today
programme.desc: In-depth, comprehensive daily coverage of all aspects of the NBA from expert analysts.

programme.title: NFL Live
programme.desc: Host Laura Rutledge takes the helm of this weekday show featuring the likes of Marcus Spears, Dan Orlovsky, Mina Kimes, and Adam Schefter. The "NFL Live" crew entertains fans while offering all the latest news and analysis from across the NFL.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Designed for Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler’s mastery of propaganda, and his instinctive skill for effective design, helps win huge popular support for the Nazi party, a vital step in its march towards total power.

programme.title: Hitler's Highways
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler promises to make Germany great again with his ambitious plans to create 22,000 kms of motorway and build one and half million “People’s Cars” every year.

programme.title: The Industry of War
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler is determined to rebuild Germany’s military strength after its humiliating defeat in the First World War by stealing raw materials from abroad.

programme.title: A Culture of Control
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler is determined to change the way German people think and feel by creating a new, Nazi form of art and culture. He takes control of all forms of media to spread Nazi propaganda.

programme.title: Himmler's Empire of Terror
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler’s bid for power depends on his most loyal and violent supporters, the SS. They use intimidation, detention, terror and even murder to defeat all the Nazis political enemies.

programme.title: Retreat from Reality
programme.desc: Hitler uses technology and terror to keep Germans fighting to the bitter end.

programme.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis
programme.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.

programme.title: Rising Sun
programme.desc: After briefly setting the scene, Episode One delves into the early years of Emperor Hirohito’s reign.

programme.title: For the Sake of the Country
programme.desc: Episode Two explores the military’s tightening control over Japanese society, the disbanding of labour unions and influences upon education.

programme.title: The Sun that Shines
programme.desc: Japan seized more than 2,500,000 km² of land in Southeast Asia and almost the entire western half of the Pacific.

programme.title: An Extraordinary Measure
programme.desc: On the day that Nagasaki was bombed, the Trans Baikal and 2nd Far East Fronts of the Red Army invaded Manchuria, the 1st Far East Front moved from Vladivostok.

programme.title: Countdown to Surrender: The End
programme.desc: The final act of the Second World War is its most costly episode. More than one million German soldiers die in 1945 alone.

programme.title: The Seeds of Violence 1918-1922
programme.desc: Hatred and the desire for revenge smoldered in the minds of many Germans after the First World War. Many Germans believe that the Jews are the cause of all kinds of problems.

programme.title: Deceit and Delusion 1923-1928
programme.desc: Hitler and his movement seem to be eliminated after his failed putsch on November 9, 1923, the movement is banned, the self-proclaimed leaders are imprisoned.

programme.title: Democracy without Democrats 1929-1933
programme.desc: In the late 1920s, Germany was seething. Social protest turns into a racist and anti-Jewish movement, Hitler and his NSDAP using their anger against the “system” for their own benefits.

programme.title: The Racial State 1933-1934
programme.desc: After the 1933 parliament fire, President Hindenburg signs a decree that suspends freedom of speech. In mock elections, Hitler secures approval; with terror, he intimi-dates his adversaries.

programme.title: Hidden in Plain Sight 1935-1938
programme.desc: In October 1934, Hitler's government is firmly in the saddle. The majority of Germans support Hitler's offensive anti-Jewish policy.

programme.title: Up in Flames 1936-1940
programme.desc: At the end of 1939, the German Army has invaded Poland. They are followed closely by the SS (Schutzstaffel) task forces, which have only one mission: To murder the Polish intelligence.

programme.title: The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis
programme.desc: "The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis" presents documents and footage proving the royal family’s and leading British aristocrats’ sympathy for National Socialism.

programme.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis
programme.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.

programme.title: Concrete Against Bombs
programme.desc: The first programme features four bunkers built before World War Two. We begin with the legendary Franzensfeste in today’s northern Italy, a fortress that was never besieged.

programme.title: Facing Nuclear Annihilation
programme.desc: The second programme features shelters in the nuclear era in Lithuania, Germany and Albania.

programme.title: What if Hitler Had Won the War
programme.desc: The documentary addresses the counterfactual question of a Nazi victory in the Second World War and is asking at the same time how history would have evolved without Hitler.

programme.title: Shera
programme.desc: Jai is married to a police inspector and leads a happy life, until his sister is killed one day. In an attempt to avenge her death, he confronts the perpetrators that put him at odds with his wife.

programme.title: Mafia
programme.desc: Inspector Bhagat Singh is brutally murdered, but the killers are never found. His brothers, Ajit and Jai Singh, decide to find the culprits and learn that he was killed by none other than the police.

programme.title: Pati Patni Aur Tawaif
programme.desc: A successful actor risks destroying his family life when he falls in love with an actress. He faces a dilemma when the actress decides to leave him and take away their daughter.

programme.title: Balwaan
programme.desc: Arjun Singh joins the police force to fight corruption and maintain justice. However, he encounters many obstacles from the infamous gangster Bhaiji and several corrupt officers.

programme.title: Jwalamukhi
programme.desc: A senior police officer dedicated to change the political and social systems of a village, gets killed by the goons. However, his spirit seeks revenge and helps a cop strike against his murderers.

programme.title: Gautam Govinda
programme.desc: Gautam, a dedicated officer, is transferred to a town that is teeming with criminals and ruled by Dharamdutt. In order to tackle Gautam, Dharamdutt sends his most able and trusted man, Govinda.

programme.title: Policewala Gunda
programme.desc: An honest police officer lives with his mother, stepfather and stepbrother. When a criminal, who intends to join politics, lures his stepbrother into the world of crime, he must go against him.

programme.title: Lok Parlok
programme.desc: Due to a mistake of Lord Brahma, Naresh is born immune to all diseases and death. He falls in love with Yamaja, the daughter of Yamraj and struggles to save his family and marry his love.

programme.title: Sabse Badhkar Hum
programme.desc: Amar's life takes a dark turn when his family is murdered by a gangster. Years later, he becomes a police officer and vows to avenge the destruction of his family.

programme.title: Janatha Garage
programme.desc: When Anand visits Hyderabad, he encounters Sathyam, who operates an organisation aiding the underprivileged. Sathyam, swayed by Anand's vision, hands over the organisation's management to him.

programme.title: Lift
programme.desc: A man's first day on the job turns into a nightmare after some vengeful spirits begin to create trouble by trapping him in an elevator.

programme.title: Super Khiladi 4
programme.desc: A simple young man, falls in love with a woman at first sight. However, he is disheartened after finding that the girl's father has arranged her wedding elsewhere.

programme.title: Gurkha
programme.desc: A group of ex-army officials takes innocent people at a shopping centre hostage. When a security guard of Gurkha descent learns that the captives include the woman he loves, he sets out to save them.

programme.title: Donnie Darko
programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. After surviving a freak accident, Donnie (Jake Gyllenhaal) begins to explore what it means to be alive, and in short order to be in love, he uncovers secrets of the universe that give him a tempting power to alter time and destiny.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: A collision between two massive rocks in outer space sends a large meteor hurtling toward Earth.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: A collision between two massive rocks in outer space sends a large meteor hurtling toward Earth.

programme.desc: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: Following real-life murder investigation as it is being conducted in real time, using raw and unfiltered footage, including body-cam and surveillance footage, to bring out the truth.

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: Exploring the ripple effects of a single murder on multiple lives, as loved ones, eyewitnesses and law enforcement personnel reflect on how the past continues to haunt the present.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here
programme.desc: A retelling of the truly chilling, real-life stories of people who shared their homes and their lives with loved ones who turned into killers. Plus, interviews and firsthand accounts of the critical moments leading up to the vicious acts.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: True Conviction
programme.desc: Anna-Sigga Nicolazzi examines cases through the eyes of a prosecutor and shares her insights into how the complex threads of a murder investigation come together in the courtroom.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: An exploration into the dangers of meeting up with strangers through Internet dating sites. Featuring stories from families and friends of victims who have fallen victim to online predators.

programme.title: Hollywood Demons
programme.desc: Revealing dark realities behind fame's glittering facade from cursed dynasties.

programme.title: Mother, May I Murder?
programme.desc: When the relationship between mothers and their children becomes a breeding ground for conspiracy, manipulation and murder, this toxic bond leaves a trail of misery and destruction throughout America.

programme.sub-title: Nandu, a 50-year-old financier, struggles with his past actions as he searches for his rival, experiencing a journey of reflection that delves into his inner turmoil and shadowed decisions
programme.desc: 50 வயதான நிதி ஆலோசகரான நந்து, தனது எதிரியைத் தேடிச் செல்லும் பயணத்தில், கடந்த காலச் செயல்களால் மனப்போராட்டத்திற்கு உள்ளாகிறார். அந்தப் பயணம், அவரது அகத்தின் போராட்டத்தையும் இருண்ட முடிவுகளையும் ஆழமாக ஆராயும் ஒரு சுய-சிந்தனைப் பயணமாக அமைகிறது.

programme.sub-title: Gopi, the owner of a tailor shop and son of Chokkalingam, a Nadaswaram player, goes about his daily life, with several ups and downs, along with his family
programme.desc: தையல்கடை உரிமையாளரும், நாதஸ்வரம் வாசிக்கும் சொக்கலிங்கத்தின் மகனுமான கோபி பல ஏற்ற தாழ்வுகளை குடும்பத்தோடு கடக்கிறார்.

programme.title: கௌரி
programme.sub-title: Gowri descends to the mortal world in order to defeat the evil powers that attempt to threaten the peace and well-being of humanity
programme.desc: கௌரி மனிதகுலத்தின் அமைதி மற்றும் நல்வாழ்வை அச்சுறுத்தும் தீய சக்திகளை தோற்கடிப்பதற்காக மரண உலகத்திற்குள் இறங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: பவித்ரா
programme.sub-title: After the demise of her parents, a young girl named Pavithra returns to her grandmother's house, where she experiences a series of events
programme.desc: தன் பெற்றோர் இறந்தபின், பவித்ரா என்ற இளம் பெண் தனது பாட்டி வீட்டிற்கு திரும்பியபோது தொடர்ச்சியான நிகழ்வுகளை காண்கிறார்.

programme.title: படே அச்சே லக்தே ஹைன்
programme.sub-title: Ram and Priya, two individuals that are worlds apart, enter an arranged marriage. Soon, they face challenges that alter their relationship
programme.desc: திருமண ஒப்பந்தத்தில் நுழையும் அந்நியர்களான ராம் மற்றும் பிரியா விரைவில்,தங்கள் உறவை மாற்றும் சவால்களை எதிர்கொள்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: இனி எல்லாம் வசந்தமே
programme.sub-title: After Dev loses his father at a young age, he gets very attached to his mother. However, his mother dislikes the woman he loves and keeps him in a position where he must choose between the two

programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S28 E10 — The Scratchin' Post, Failure is an Option, and Practical Jokes A cat tries to drink a man's coffee; a cat curbs its appetite by stealing an entire bag of meat; the crazy antics of cats and other pets.
programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos

programme.desc: S28 E11 — Superheroes, Seniors, and Dog Park Ten finalists compete for a $100,000 prize; wind blows homework out of a backpack; a toddler refuses vegetables; a mom discovers a huge mess; a dog gets excited by a dog puppet; a woman tests a bug zapper; a man sings Christmas carols in his car.
programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos

programme.desc: S28 E12 — Fathers and Sons, Birthdays, and Goats A young girl thinks a photo of George Washington is her Aunt Marsha; a young boy tries to command music to be played from a non-existing device; a baby accidentally orders $900 concert tickets from his aunt's phone; goats caught on camera.
programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos

programme.desc: S05 E16 — El Paso, Pt. 1 The group heads to El Paso for the weekend to watch Pauly spin and join in on some line dancing; it's love at first bite when Mike eats his first Texas tacos, but it's anything but love between Angelina and the girls.
programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation

programme.desc: S05 E17 — El Paso, Pt. 2 The party continues when DJ Pauly D takes on El Paso and the meatballs take on an owl. But it's a FaceTime from Angelina that takes Mike over the edge.
programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation

programme.desc: S05 E18 — Messy Mike Jenni shines a light on a cause close to her heart; Angelina has a long-overdue sit-down with Snooki and Deena.
programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation

programme.desc: S05 E19 — Mike vs. the World The messiness finally catches up to Mike in an epic showdown with Angelina and an emotional confrontation with Jenni.
programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation

programme.desc: S05 E20 — The Meatball Show Ronnie returns to New Jersey to meet up with Mike and Deena; Nicole welcomes Jerry Springer and Amy Schumer to Deena's backyard.
programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation

programme.desc: S05 E21 — The Pool Party The Guidos head to San Diego for a family vacation, but before the fun can begin there's a lot that needs to be settled.
programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation

programme.desc: S28 E13 — Siblings, Snow, and Animals With Zippers Versus People With Zappers Annoyed siblings; dogs in slow motion; a girl believes dad's laser pointer is Tinkerbell.

programme.title: அம்மன் கோவில்கள்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and cultural significance of various temples and shrines dedicated to Goddess Amman
programme.desc: தேவி அம்மனுக்கான பல்வேறு கோவில்கள் மற்றும் சன்னதிகளின் மத மற்றும் கலாச்சார முக்கியத்துவத்தை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: சிவாலயம்
programme.sub-title: At a revered temple in Kerala, priests and devotees unite in devotion, performing sacred rituals and offering heartfelt prayers to Lord Shiva
programme.desc: கேரளாவின் பிரபல கோவிலில், பூசாரிகள்-பக்தர்கள் இணைந்து, சடங்குகளை செய்து, சிவனுக்கு இதயப்பூர்வ வழிபாடுகளை செய்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: கும்பாபிஷேகம்
programme.sub-title: Devotees in large numbers visit a temple to perform a special ritual in order to synergise and unite the special powers of the deity
programme.desc: தெய்வத்தின் சிறப்பு சக்திகளை ஒருங்கிணைக்கவும் ஒன்றிணைக்கவும் ஒரு சிறப்பு சடங்கை செய்ய பக்தர்கள் கோயிலுக்கு வருகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஆர்ஜேஆர் - ஹெர்பல் ஸ்லாட்
programme.sub-title: The host promotes the services offered by RJR Herbal Hospital, where patients receive Ayurvedic treatment to treat various health problems
programme.desc: நோயாளிகளுக்கு சிகிச்சையளிக்க ஆயுர்வேத சிகிச்சையை வழங்கும் ஆர்ஜேஆர் ஹெர்பல் மருத்துவமனை சேவைகளை விளம்பரப்படுத்துகிறது.

programme.desc: ஆன்மீக ஞானத்தையும் சைவ சமயத்தைப் பற்றிய தகவல்களையும் பாராயணங்கள் மூலம் புனித தமிழ் வேதங்கள் உயிர்ப்பிக்கப்படுகின்றன.

programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: ரிலீஜியஸ் ப்ரோக்ராம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty to enlighten the devotees and guide them on a path of spiritual growth
programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்

programme.desc: திறமையான நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு அன்றாட வாழ்க்கைக் காட்சிகள்-நிகழ்வுகள் நகைச்சுவையான திருப்பத்துடன் இயற்றுகின்றனர்.

programme.title: கானா பேட்டை
programme.sub-title: A group of talented youngsters and musicians perform a compilation of entertaining folk songs expressing various social themes
programme.desc: இளைஞர்கள்-இசைக்கலைஞர்கள் சமூக கருப்பொருள்களை வெளிப்படுத்தும் பொழுதுபோக்கு கிராமிய பாடல்களின் தொகுப்பை நிகழ்த்துகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: ரிலீஜியஸ் ப்ரோக்ராம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty to enlighten the devotees and guide them on a path of spiritual growth
programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்

programme.desc: ஆன்மீகத் தலைவர் ஆழ்ந்த ஞானத்தைப் பகிர்ந்து இந்து கடவுளான கிருஷ்ணரின் வாழ்க்கையை விவரிக்கும் தகவல் உரையை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சிவாலயம்
programme.sub-title: At a revered temple in Kerala, priests and devotees unite in devotion, performing sacred rituals and offering heartfelt prayers to Lord Shiva
programme.desc: கேரளாவின் பிரபல கோவிலில், பூசாரிகள்-பக்தர்கள் இணைந்து, சடங்குகளை செய்து, சிவனுக்கு இதயப்பூர்வ வழிபாடுகளை செய்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: டகல்.காம்
programme.sub-title: Talented comedians enact various daily life scenarios, current events and socio-political issues with a hilarious twist
programme.desc: திறமையான நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு அன்றாட வாழ்க்கைக் காட்சிகள்-நிகழ்வுகள் நகைச்சுவையான திருப்பத்துடன் இயற்றுகின்றனர்.

programme.title: கானா பேட்டை
programme.sub-title: A group of talented youngsters and musicians perform a compilation of entertaining folk songs expressing various social themes
programme.desc: இளைஞர்கள்-இசைக்கலைஞர்கள் சமூக கருப்பொருள்களை வெளிப்படுத்தும் பொழுதுபோக்கு கிராமிய பாடல்களின் தொகுப்பை நிகழ்த்துகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: ரிலீஜியஸ் ப்ரோக்ராம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty to enlighten the devotees and guide them on a path of spiritual growth
programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: John Legend
programme.sub-title: Live in London
programme.desc: An artist with intellectual skills is John Legend, who studied English with a major in African American literature at the University of Pennsylvania. In college, he participated in a jazz group called Counterparts and at the time was introduced to singer Lauryn Hill, playing piano on the track 'Everything Is Everything' from the singer's first solo album. He finished college in 1999 and began composing his own songs Recorded two independent albums that were sold in their performances: 'John Stephens' (2000) and 'Live at Jimmy Uptown' (2001). He has performed on albums of singers like Alicia Key, Jay-Z and also made the album Wake Up! (2010) along with the American rap group, The Roots. His official discography includes Get Lifted (2004), Once Again (2006), Evolver (2008) and Love in the Future (2013). This presentation in London, 2014, at the Itunes Festival, manages to clean the career of this singer who besides being multitalented can be a human rights activist.

programme.title: Bachman & Turner
programme.sub-title: Live
programme.desc: Randy Bachman and C.F. “Fred” Turner were the core members of Bachman-Turner Overdrive throughout their commercial heyday in the seventies, sharing duties on the lead vocals with Bachman contributing lead guitar and Turner the bass. Between them they also composed the vast majority of the band's many hit singles. Reuniting at the end of 2009 they released an eponymous album in 2010 and in November of that year they performed at the famous Roseland Ballroom in New York City as part of their North American tour.

programme.title: राजाजी
programme.sub-title: Raja, a young man, wants an easy life and marries for wealth and comfort. He soon finds out that there is an underlying secret of his wife and feels trapped
programme.desc: राजा, आरामदायक जीवन व्यतीत करने के लिए एक करोड़पति की बेटी, पायल से शादी करता है। लेकिन जब उसे पता चलता है कि वह वास्तव में करोड़पति के माली की बेटी है, तो वह उसे छोड़ देता है।.

programme.title: हाथ की सफाई
programme.sub-title: Brothers Raju and Shankar, who are separated by fate, cross paths with each other in Mumbai when Kamini, a wealthy runaway, unintentionally barges into their lives
programme.desc: अपने भाई से अलग हुआ अनाथ,राज मुंबई शहर में भूखा और अकेला रहता है।उसे एक पाकिट मारने वाला आदमी मिलता है जिसके साथ मिलकर वह शातिर चोर बनता है,वहीं उसकी दोस्ती अमीर,कामिनी से होती है जो घर से भाग आयी है।.

credits.actor: Vinod Khanna (Shankar Kumar),Randhir Kapoor (Raj Kumar/Raju Tardeo),Hema Malini (Kamini Chopra),Simi Garewal (Roma S Kumar),Ranjeet (Ranjeet),D.K. Sapru (Baba Sheikh),Satyen Kappu (Usmanbhai Bombay),Viju Khote (Damodar)

programme.title: कमांडो
programme.sub-title: A disavowed commando escapes captivity after a year of torture at the hands of the Chinese. On his way back to India, he is roped into protecting a woman from a local goon that wants to marry her
programme.desc: एक बेवफ़ा कमांडो, एक साल तक चीनी लोगों की प्रताड़णा सहने के बाद कैद से भाग जाता है। भारत लौटते समय, उसे एक स्थानीय गुंडे से एक महिला को बचाने का काम सौंपा जाता है जो उससे शादी करना चाहता है।.

credits.actor: Vidyut Jamwal,Pooja Chopra,Jaideep Ahlawat,Sukhwinder Chahal,Darshan Jariwala,Jagat Rawat,Baljinder Kaur,Nathan Barris

programme.title: पत्थर के सनम
programme.sub-title: Meena and Taruna tease their new manager Rajesh, but both fall for him. An attack on Rajesh brings his mother to town, which reveals a dark past and leads to tragedy
programme.desc: राजेश, मीना के पिता के लिए काम करता है, मीना और उसकी दोस्त तरूणा उसके साथ प्रैंक खेलने का फैसला करती है। दोनों महिलाएं उससे प्यार करने का नाटक करती हैं, लेकिन उसे सच पता चलता हैं जिससे कटुता आती है।.

programme.title: हीरा
programme.sub-title: Heera is wrongly accused of murder and is sentenced to death, but he manages to escape from prison and becomes a bandit. He tries to prove his innocence and kills anyone who comes in his way
programme.desc: हीरा पर हत्या का आरोप लगाया जाता है और उसे मौत की सजा सुनाई जाती है।वह जेल से भाग जाता है और डाकू बन जाता है।वह अपनी बेगुनाही साबित करने की कोशिश में हर उस व्यक्ति को मारता हैजो उसके रास्तेमें आता है।.

credits.actor: Sunil Dutt (Heera),Asha Parekh (Asha),Shatrughan Sinha (Balwant),Mukri (Manglu),Kanahiyalal (Dhaniram),Anwar Hussain (Changu),Farida Jalal,Helen

programme.title: इज़्ज़त
programme.sub-title: A man sets out to avenge his late mother, who was molested and abandoned by his biological father. He finds history repeating itself when he sees his half-brother following in his father's footsteps
programme.desc: आदिवासी लड़का अपने मृत माँ का प्रतिशोध चाहता है जिसे अमीर आदमी ने उपयोग कर छोड़ दिया था। वह यही इतिहास को दोहराता पाता है, जब उसका सौतेला भाई आदिवासी लड़की से प्यार करता है, लेकिन शादी से इनकर करता है।.

programme.title: नया रास्ता
programme.sub-title: Chander, a criminal lawyer, gives up his successful career and returns to his village. However, things take a turn as he comes face-to-face with various social problems
programme.desc: एक आपराधिक वकील चंदर, अपना सफल करियर छोड़कर अपने पैतृक गांव लौट जाता है। वहाँ वह जातिवाद, छुआछूत और गरीबी जैसी सामाजिक समस्याओं का सामना करता है।.

credits.actor: Jeetendra,Asha Parekh,Balraj Sahni,Farida Jalal,Sujit Kumar,Veena,Lalita Pawar,Kishan Mehta

programme.title: बहारों की मंजिल
programme.sub-title: A woman is injured in an accident and loses all her memory with her husband and daughter. She claims to be another woman who is believed to have died sixteen years ago
programme.desc: एक महिला दुर्घटना में घायल हो जाती है और अपने पति और बेटी से संबंधित यादों को भूल जाती है। वह अन्य महिला होने का दावा करती है, जिसकी मृत्यु सोलह साल पहले हो चुकी है।.

programme.title: खामोशी: द म्यूजिकल
programme.sub-title: Annie, a hearing- and speech-impaired couple's daughter, meets Raj who brings music and love to her life. However, she has to overcome obstacles when her family refuses to accept their relationship
programme.desc: मुक-बधिर जोड़े की बेटी एनी, राज से मिलती है जो उसके जीवन में संगीत और प्यार लाता है। हालाँकि, एनी का परिवार इस रिश्ते को अस्वीकार करता है, जिसके कारण वह संघर्षों का सामना करती है।.

credits.actor: Manisha Koirala,Nana Patekar,Seema Biswas,Salman Khan,Helen,Priya Parukelar,Himani Shivpuri,Raghubir Yadav

programme.title: Omar Sosa, Childo Tomas, Ernesto Simpson & Leandro Saint-Hill
programme.sub-title: Omar Sosa - Quarteto Afrocubano
programme.desc: While always keeping one foot firmly anchored in the traditions of his home country, Cuba, Omar Sosa tirelessly explores music from the Caribbean to India, and West Africa to the Arab world. Since he left Cuba in 1993, the pianist has been blending his Afro-Cuban roots with jazz, hip hop, electro and world music. For his 2018 performance at Théâtre de Villefranche-sur-Saône, he brings to stage his Quarteto Afrocubano members Childo Tomas (electric bass & vocals), Ernesto Simpson (drums), and Leandro Saint-Hill (saxophones, flute, percussion & vocals). Together, they create a riveting instrumental dialogue. Celebrating rhythm in all its forms, this Omar Sosa concert is an intense and mystical experience.

programme.title: Charlie Parker
programme.sub-title: The Story of Jazz
programme.desc: The documentary The Story of Jazz is a seamless array of performances, commentary, and compelling historic insights about jazz, zooming in on the cross-cultural influences that produced this constantly evolving and enduring music. Many call jazz the greatest art form of the 20th century. This absorbing weave of sounds, rare film clips, stills and interviews shows how this truly American expression spread to become a universal, musical language, from the New Orleans traditions, stride, swing, boogie woogie, big band, jump band, blues, bebop, Afro-Cuban, cool, and free-form, to jazz vocalists and dancers… Never before have the filmed comments of so many important great jazz artists been assembled for one project, and never before has the history of jazz been told as vividly and with such attention to historic detail.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.sub-title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Woody Herman, Paul Fontaine, Billy Hunt & Bill Chase
programme.sub-title: Woody Herman's Swinging Herd live in England 1964
programme.desc: Woody Herman: Live in '64 features a blistering one-hour concert from 1964 showcasing one of the very hottest line-ups of the "Swinging Herd," including trumpeter Bill Chase, trombonist Phil Wilson, and the amazing saxophonist Sal Nistico on the front line, as well as drummer Jake Hanna, bassist Chuck Andrus, and pianist-arranger Nat Pierce in the rhythm section. The band roars throughout the entire show which includes standards such as "Lonesome Old Town", "After You've Gone", and new originals including Charles Mingus's "Better Git It In Your Soul."

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.sub-title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jo Jones & Milt Buckner
programme.sub-title: Jo Jones & Milt Buckner - Radio Télévision Suisse
programme.desc: In early September 1969, the duo of American drummer ‘Papa' Jo Jones (1911–1985) and American organist Milt Buckner (1915–1977) played a string of jazz concerts in Switzerland. Jo Jones, who pioneered playing timekeeping rhythms on a cymbal rather than the bass drum, became renowned in the 1930s in the Count Basie Orchestra. Milt Buckner rose to prominence as a pianist in the Lionel Hampton Orchestra in the 1940s, yet devoted himself to the organ in the 1950s. Swiss actor Jean Landier welcomed the two musicians to the Radio Télévision Suisse program ‘Variétés: Jasons Jazz' for a short interview, followed by performances of ‘Hamp's Boogie Woogie', ‘Georgia Mae', ‘Tea For Two', and ‘Flying Home'.

programme.title: Eliane Elias
programme.sub-title: Münchner Klaviersommer: Eliane Elias Trio
programme.desc: There's no question about it: with a Grammy for Best Latin Jazz Album for her recording ‘Made In Brazil', seven previous Grammy nominations, four ‘Gold Disc Awards', and three ‘Best Vocal Album Awards' in Japan, Eliane Elias has taken her place in the pantheon of music giants. In her projects, Elias wears many hats: she serves as producer, composer, lyricist, arranger, pianist, and vocalist. In this concert broadcast, recorded live at the Philharmonie in Munich, Elias shows her distinctive and immediately recognizable musical style, which blends her Brazilian samba roots and her sensuous, alluring voice with her impressive instrumental bebop, jazz, classical, and compositional skills. She is an artist beyond category, and in this concert she performs with Jay Randall Anderson (bass) and Adam Nussbaum (drums).

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.sub-title: Things Are Here
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Les McCann
programme.sub-title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record. McCann moves comfortably from one jazz style to the next, demonstrating impressive chops in all areas, from bop to fusion, and from vocals to the keys of the electric piano, clavinet, or synthesizer. His mix of church and swing music captures the spirit of the time perfectly, even when an illness prevented him from playing with more than one finger at a time in the early 1990s. In today's broadcast, McCann takes gospel back to New Orleans, where he played this set in 1983. McCann's vocals shine in the soulful performances of several of his hits, including “Just Like Magic”, backed by his wonderful “Magic Band” of saxophonist Bobby Bryant Jr., bassist Curtis Robertson Jr., and drummer Tony St. James.

programme.title: Shark Paradise
programme.desc: Leave your worries from the world above behind and dive into a vibrant undersea world inhabited by the iconic sharks, for 80 minutes of Nature Relaxation. Captured by filmmaker collaborator Peter Schneider, Shark Paradise features hundreds of unique real-time scenes captured from around the world, paired with gentle underwater sounds & calming music for deep relaxation by Relax Moods.

programme.title: America from Above
programme.desc: "America From Above" is a spectacular yet ultra-soothing 1-hour long natural journey that sweeps viewers gently above America's vistas. You'll begin the farmlands of Iowa, soaring west through the Rocky Mountains of Colorado, then on to Utah's iconic red rock landscapes and finally ending on the West Coast with a familiar voyage over Big Sur and then back to San Diego just in time for sunset.

programme.title: மூவி
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: திரைப்படங்களில் சிறந்தவை.

programme.title: அண்ணாமலை
programme.sub-title: Generations of rivalry come to light as two families fight for control of a revered temple while personal emotions complicate the path to peace
programme.desc: தனிப்பட்ட உணர்வுகள் அமைதிக்கான பாதையை சிக்கலாக்கும் அதே வேளையில், ஒரு புனிதமான கோவிலின் கட்டுப்பாட்டிற்காக இரண்டு குடும்பங்கள் சண்டையிடுவதால், தலைமுறையாக இருந்துவரும் அவர்களின் பகைமை வெளிச்சத்திற்கு வருகிறது.

credits.actor: Sivakumar,Radikaa Sarathkumar,Shyam Ganesh,Kuyili,Ponvannan,Viji Chandrasekhar,Shanmuga Sundaram,Jyothi Lakshmi

programme.title: தாமரை
programme.sub-title: Sneha and Dwarkesh fall in love, and they secretly register their marriage. However, their relationship is tested as they face various obstacles
programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

credits.actor: Pavithra Gowda (Sakthi),Amaljith (Eshwar),Nivisha (Durga),Surjith Ansary (Kishore),Nanditha Jennifer (Saradha),Nisha Jagadeeswaran (Logambal),Shaliy Avinesh (Logambal),Shobana (Naga),Anita Nair (Lakshmi),Rathan Ganapathy (Mahendran),Avinash Ashok (Aravindh),Anu Sulash (Neha),Shubha Raksha (Inba)

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கர்ணா
programme.sub-title: Karna, the son of the Sun God and Kunti, faces hardships from birth but strives to prove his worth. Overcoming challenges, he rises to become one of the most formidable archers and warriors in the Mahabharata
programme.desc: பிறப்பிலிருந்தே பல சவால்களை தாண்டி மகாபாரதத்தில் சிறந்த வில்லாளி மற்றும் போர்வீரராகும் சூரியன், குந்தியின் மகன் கர்ணன்.

programme.title: தெனாலி ராமன்
programme.sub-title: Tenali Raman, an advisor at the court of King Krishnadevaraya, uses his sharp presence of mind and wisdom to solve the difficult matters of the kingdom and its people daily
programme.desc: தனது கூர்மையான மனதையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்தி, ராஜ்ஜியம் மற்றும் மக்களின் கடினமான விஷயங்களை தீர்க்கும் தெனாலி ராமன்.

credits.actor: Krishna Bharadwaj,Pankaj Berry,Manav Gohil,Jitendra Pathak,Sohit Soni,Sanjay Mangnani,Priyamvada Kant,Nimisha Vakharia

programme.title: வானம்பாடி
programme.sub-title: Two sisters, Thulasi and Manasi, face a fork in the road with impending difficulties when one of them chooses to marry the son of their father's enemy
programme.desc: சகோதரிகளான துளசி மற்றும் மானசியில் ஒருத்தி தங்கள் தந்தையினுடைய எதிரி மகனை மணக்கத் தீர்மானிக்கும்போது, வரவிருக்கும் சிக்கல்களுடன் கூடிய ஒரு திருப்புமுனையை அவர்கள் எதிர்கொள்கிறார்கள்.

credits.actor: Archana Nair (Thulasi),Vishnu Prasad (Karali Chandran),Akash Murali (Nand),Lydia Paul (Manasi)

programme.title: அலாதின்
programme.desc: Aladdin, a poor thief, discovers a magical lamp containing a Genie. However, soon he realizes that Zafar, an evil sorcerer, also desires the lamp to rule over Baghdad.

credits.actor: Siddharth Nigam,Aamir Dalvi,Smita Bansal,Avneet Kaur,Raashul Tandon

programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular and beloved musical numbers from the year, played consecutively

programme.title: The High Road With Keith Warren

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.sub-title: The manufacturing of Skippy peanut butter, aubergine Parmesan, Wonderful pistachios and chocolate bars filled with tortilla chips and candy
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.sub-title: How did Harry Houdini pull off his death-defying escapes? A team of experts investigates his illusions to reveal the secrets of this mysterious stunt
programme.desc: Cracking a magician's code used to be strictly against industry standards. Now, it seems the magic has disappeared from that concept, and even legendary performers such as Harry Houdini are not immune. This series looks to uncover the methods to Houdini's breathtaking escapes and astonishing illusions, which have never been equalled or fully understood. How did this showman catch a speeding bullet, submerge himself in a water torture cell, or survive being buried alive? Helping piece together clues and testing out his most daring stunts are Houdini's grand-nephew George Hardeen, magician and daredevil Lee Terbosic, and master stunt builder Steve Wolf.
